gloss: to make light of; to belittle; to underestimate

definitions.gloss: to make light of; to belittle; to underestimate
definitions.explanation: To treat something as unimportant or less significant than it actually is. To give inadequate attention or respect to something that deserves more.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽視|けいし}して⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: You must not make light of safety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽視|けいし}するべきで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: You should not dismiss his opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{基礎|きそ}→基礎：03981_kiso⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軽視|けいし}される⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{長期的|ちょうきてき}→長期的：20406_choukiteki⟧な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: When basic research is undervalued, it affects long-term technological development.

notes:
The opposite of ⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧ (to value highly, to take seriously). Carries a critical tone, implying that the thing being {軽視|けいし}された deserves more attention.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽視|けいし}する: to neglect safety
- ⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軽視|けいし}する: to disregard human rights
- ⟦{軽視|けいし}できない→軽視する：18776_keishi⟧: cannot be taken lightly
- {軽視|けいし}されがちな: tends to be overlooked

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧: to value, to regard as important — the antonym, meaning to give proper weight and attention to something
- ⟦{無視|むし}する→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧: to ignore — stronger than ⟦{軽視|けいし}→軽視：14305_keishi⟧; means to completely disregard, while ⟦{軽視|けいし}→軽視：14305_keishi⟧ means to give insufficient attention
- ⟦{見下|みくだ}す→見下す：09911_mikudasu⟧: to look down on — specifically directed at people and implies contempt, while ⟦{軽視|けいし}→軽視：14305_keishi⟧ can apply to concepts, issues, and opinions as well
